```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(c("R/read_data.R", "R/remove_future_observations.R",
       "R/transform_means.R"),
     ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

accounts <- triggerR$read_trigger_accounts() %>%
  select(userId, nationality)

if (!exists("trigger_hourly_wide_tans")){
  trigger_hourly_wide_tans <- triggerR$read_hourly(format = "wide",
                                                  only_mean = TRUE,
                                                  min_5min = 6) %>%
    triggerR$drop_future() %>%
    triggerR$transform_means() %>%
    pluck("data") %>%
    select(-starts_with(c("accuracy", "longitude", "latitude"))) %>%
    select(-ends_with("5min_n"))
  }

env_vars <- c("particle_PC1", "particle_PC2", "temperature", "humidity",
              "pressure", "sound", "light")
phy_vars <- c("heartrate", "breathrate", "bodytemp", "skintemp", "step",
              "bplow", "bphigh", "oxygens")
```

```{r}
coverage <- list(
  environmental = env_vars,
  physiological = phy_vars,
  physiological_without_oxygens = setdiff(phy_vars, "oxygens"),
  physiological_without_breathrate = setdiff(phy_vars, "breathrate"),
  physiological_without_oxygens_breathrate = setdiff(phy_vars, c("oxygens", "breathrate")),
  combined = c(env_vars, phy_vars),
  combined_without_oxygens = c(env_vars, setdiff(phy_vars, "oxygens")),
  combined_without_oxygens_breathrate = c(env_vars, setdiff(phy_vars, c("oxygens", "breathrate")))) %>%
  imap(\(vars, block) {
    available <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |> filter(if_any(all_of(vars), is.finite))
    complete <- available |> filter(if_all(all_of(vars), is.finite))

    tibble(
      block = block,
      available_buckets_n = nrow(available), complete_buckets_n = nrow(complete),
      retained_pct = 100 * nrow(complete) / nrow(available),
      available_participants_n = n_distinct(available$userId),
      complete_participants_n = n_distinct(complete$userId)
    )}) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-cap: Percentage of complete hourly observations across variable sets. Environmental data show high completeness (96.5%), while excluding oxygen saturation and respiratory rate substantially improves physiological completeness (48.3%) and combined completeness (11.1%).

coverage |>
  mutate(block = factor(block, levels = rev(block))) |>
  ggplot(aes(retained_pct, block, fill = block)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", retained_pct)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  ggqualpal::scale_fill_qualpal() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 110), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(x = "Complete observations (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-caption: Number of complete hourly observations after excluding each physiological variable individually. Oxygen saturation (oxygens) and respiratory rate (breathrate) are the main limiting variables, increasing complete observations from 16,977 to 81,364 and 46,878, respectively, when excluded.

map(phy_vars, \(excluded) {
  complete <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
    filter(if_all(all_of(setdiff(phy_vars, excluded)), is.finite))

  tibble(excluded = excluded, complete_buckets_n = nrow(complete),
         participants_n = n_distinct(complete$userId))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  ggplot(aes(complete_buckets_n, fct_reorder(excluded, complete_buckets_n), fill = excluded)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::label_comma()(complete_buckets_n)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "Complete hourly observations", y = "Excluded variable") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
phy_vars_filt <- setdiff(phy_vars, c("oxygens","breathrate"))
```

```{r}
phy_complete <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
  select(userId, hour_ts, all_of(phy_vars_filt)) |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(phy_vars_filt), is.finite))

variance_summary <- map(phy_vars_filt, \(variable) {
  x <- phy_complete[[variable]]
  tibble(variable, mean = mean(x), median = median(x), variance = var(x), 
         sd = sd(x), iqr = IQR(x), distinct_n = n_distinct(x))
}) |> list_rbind()

variance_summary
```

## Physiological PCA

PCA of five-minute physiological and activity means. Variables are standardized; steps are already log-transformed. No participant-specific centering is applied.

```{r}
phy_pca <- phy_complete |>
  select(all_of(phy_vars_filt)) |>
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

phy_variance <- tibble(
  component = factor(paste0("PC", seq_along(phy_pca$sdev))),
  variance = phy_pca$sdev^2 / sum(phy_pca$sdev^2)
) |> mutate(cumulative = cumsum(variance))
```

### Explained variance

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3

ggplot(phy_variance, aes(component, variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumulative, group = 1), colour = "#D55E00") +
  geom_point(aes(y = cumulative), colour = "#D55E00", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Explained variance") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Loadings

Weights of each variable in the first three components.

```{r}
phy_loadings <- phy_pca$rotation[, 1:3] |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable, names_to = "component", values_to = "loading") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(phy_vars_filt)))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.5

ggplot(phy_loadings, aes(loading, variable, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ component, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5

factoextra::fviz_pca_biplot(
  phy_pca,
  geom.ind = "point",
  col.ind = "#0072B2",
  alpha.ind = 0.05,
  pointsize = 0.1,
  col.var = "#B2182B",
  label = "var",
  repel = TRUE,
  ggtheme = theme_bw())
```

```{r}
phy_scores <- phy_complete |>
  select(userId, hour_ts) |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(phy_pca$x[, 1:2]))
```

```{r}
ggplot(phy_scores, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = 100) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", fill = "Observations") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
phy_scores |>
  left_join(
    phy_complete |>
      select(userId, hour_ts, step, bodytemp, skintemp),
    by = c("userId", "hour_ts"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = 80) +
  facet_wrap(~ if_else(step == 0, "No recorded steps", "Recorded steps")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(fill = "Observations") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
umap_data <- phy_complete |> slice_sample(n = min(50000, nrow(phy_complete)))
umap_input <- umap_data |> select(all_of(phy_vars_filt)) |> scale()

phy_umap <- uwot::umap(umap_input, n_neighbors = 30, min_dist = 0.2,
                      metric = "euclidean", n_threads = 4, n_sgd_threads = 1)

umap_scores <- umap_data |>
  mutate(UMAP1 = phy_umap[, 1], UMAP2 = phy_umap[, 2],
         activity = if_else(step == 0, "No recorded steps", "Recorded steps"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

ggplot(umap_scores, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = activity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "No recorded steps" = "#0072B2",
    "Recorded steps" = "#D55E00")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 12

plots <- map(phy_vars_filt, \(variable)
  ggplot(umap_scores, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[variable]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = variable, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2",
         colour = if (variable == "step") "log1p(step)" else "Value") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
selected_users <- umap_scores |>
  mutate(region = if_else(UMAP2 > -7, "Lower island", "Other")) %>%
  filter(region == "Lower island") |>
  count(userId, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  pull(userId)

trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
  filter(userId %in% selected_users) |>
  select(userId, hour_ts, bodytemp, skintemp) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(bodytemp, skintemp),
    names_to = "variable", values_to = "temperature") |>
  filter(!is.na(temperature)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(hour_ts, temperature, colour = variable)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ userId, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    bodytemp = "#0072B2", skintemp = "#D55E00"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°C)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Environmental PCA

```{r}
env_complete <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
  select(userId, hour_ts, all_of(env_vars)) |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(env_vars), is.finite))

env_pca <- env_complete |>
  select(all_of(env_vars)) |>
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

env_variance <- tibble(
  component = factor(paste0("PC", seq_along(env_pca$sdev))),
  variance = env_pca$sdev^2 / sum(env_pca$sdev^2)
) |> mutate(cumulative = cumsum(variance))
```

### Explained variance

```{r}

```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

robust_scale <- function(x) {
  (x - median(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

env_umap_data <- env_complete |> slice_sample(n = min(50000, nrow(env_complete)))
env_umap_input <- env_umap_data |> select(all_of(env_vars)) |> scale()

set.seed(42)
env_umap <- uwot::umap(env_umap_input, n_neighbors = 30, min_dist = 0.2,
                       metric = "euclidean", n_threads = 4, n_sgd_threads = 1)

env_umap_scores <- env_umap_data |>
  mutate(UMAP1 = env_umap[, 1], UMAP2 = env_umap[, 2])
```
